title: Queued rows never offer 'Take over manually' although AC2 names queued as a take-over state and the server sets can_take_over for queued rows
detail: AC2 (lens brief + PR spec-rc4-3-row-actions.md AC2 'in-flight (queued/contact_initiated) or unreachable') says queued rows are take-over eligible; the server hook agrees; the status-picked menu drops can_take_over for Queued — AR-RC13 under-render.
recommended_fix: Add RefcheckTakeOver to the Queued menu arm gated on call.hooks.can_take_over (mirroring ContactInitiated).

title: Start confirm deviates from §7.4 verbatim copy — 'them' for 'her'
detail: §7.4 verbatim is 'text her the form now'; shipped copy says 'text them'. The code comment claims gender-neutrality 'per the rc4-2 W5 ruling', which is the objected-state copy, not the start confirm.
recommended_fix: Match §7.4 verbatim ('her'), or secure an explicit neutral-pronoun ruling covering the §7.4/§7.7 confirms before shipping.

title: Correction body copy matches neither §7.4 nor §8.3 verbatim
evidence: pub const refcheck_correction_body: String = "Check with the applicant, update the details here, and we'll send the invitation again." — UX §7.4 (line 425): "Check with Aisling, update them here, and we'll send the invitation again."; UX §8.3 (line 557): "Check with Aisling, update them here, and we'll try again."
detail: The new landlord-facing correction body substitutes 'the applicant' for 'Aisling' and 'the details here' for 'them here' — a third variant that matches neither cited spec sentence, violating the verbatim invariant.
recommended_fix: Use the §7.4 sentence verbatim (interpolating the applicant's first name like the heading does).

title: Overflow menu declares role=menu/menuitem but has no keyboard contract (no Escape, no arrow-key navigation)
evidence: attribute("aria-haspopup", "menu") / attribute("aria-expanded", ...) on the trigger; attribute("role", "menu") on the panel; attribute("role", "menuitem") on entries — no event.on_keydown anywhere in view_overflow (no Escape close, no arrow/Home/End handling).
detail: The menu announces ARIA menu semantics yet cannot be dismissed with Escape and has no arrow-key movement; keyboard users must Tab to another control to close it — a11y gap in the new affordance.
recommended_fix: Add Escape-to-close and basic arrow/Home/End handling per the ARIA menu pattern, or drop role=menu/menuitem for a plain button group.
